entry_points.summary: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for archive/$RUN/run-brief.json; full vs lite profiles; embedded run_brief_registry $def for docs/llm/run-brief-registry.json.
Embedded registry schema mapping each v1 command to profile, init/finalize anchors, primary artifact, and fallbacks.
Subcommands init, set-section, append-decision, finalize; creates and validates run-brief.json under archive/$RUN/.
Renders run-brief.json to chat, push, or json; --require hard-gates before deregister; aggregate_decisions() reads events.jsonl.
Shared finalize block inlined by /z-export: aggregate decisions, derive sections, finalize, render chat/push, --require gate.

invariants: Chat and push text are always rendered from run-brief.json — never independently authored at finalize.
Hard gate (render-run-brief.py --require) runs before deregister on registry commands for complete/shipped paths; halted paths require minimal brief (intent + outcome).
Empty decisions array is valid for full profile.
/z-stats is NOT auto-invoked at command end.
Lite profile omits approach and decisions keys entirely; only intent, outcome, and next are required.
intent max 240 chars, must not equal the command name alone; outcome max 400 chars.
Full profile approach: 1-4 bullets with no file paths (no ext: tokens or slash path segments).
gotchas: Lite profile forbids approach and decisions properties — do not emit empty arrays.
Artifact missing on early halt triggers lite brief via registry fallback chain.
Export must inline commands/_fragments/run-brief-finalize.md so Cursor/Codex/agy copies stay in sync.
Z_HARNESS_RUN_BRIEF_DEBUG=1 optionally writes a human-readable RUN_BRIEF.md mirror for local debugging (not default).
